weather.note: Original PVGIS TMY bytes are preserved. The explicit normalization changes minute 0 to 60 and singular SAVING to SAVINGS. An earlier research text copy has different bytes; its hash must not replace the canonical provider hash.

verified_limited: Native ASCII full-year shape: 3 sensors × 8,760 intervals with 4,411 solar columns, finite outputs and independent small-matrix multiplication. Non-climatic feasibility data and low exploratory settings only.
Selected-hour three-record dew-point context exactly matches all 578 annual sky RGB rows and corresponding solar definitions in eight predeclared boundary/daylight cases.
Exact piecewise-sky horizontal integral error: 0.0041024%; uniform pi L error: 0.054038%; all six orientation bins exact; solar cosine and blocked-beam checks pass.
Equal-solid-angle direct transmission with 1,024 and 4,096 rays passes all eleven finite-disc aperture points at elevated radiance. The 256-ray profile fails one offset edge.
Angle-dependent glass direct transmission agrees with the explicit engine beam at 0, 30 and 60 degrees within 0.000724%.

A 128-positive-source, 24-sensor solar transport measurement took 350.160 seconds with a sampled child peak working set of 7,798,784 bytes. Positive-source count scaling estimates 3.08 hours for annual shipping solar alone; this is not an annual measurement.

Full-year MF4 diffuse/ground ASCII sky generation produced 226,165,911 bytes in 38.579 seconds, with sampled child peak working set 249,835,520 bytes. This fits the 512 MiB scratch file limit; nine unusually-bright sky warnings are retained.

Corrected Rust adapter completed 8,760 × 24 finite nonnegative lux values in 317.948 s under concurrent verification load. Peak child working set 68,231,168 B; sampled runner-plus-child 78,712,832 B; whole scratch peak 136,546,918 B. It emitted 3,733,872 of 108,404,736 finite-disc rays across 106 bounded batches. This establishes resource feasibility, not numerical acceptance.

Actual shared-service A/B shipping exports each replayed all 8,760 × 24 values through the same frozen CLI with zero observed lux differences. Caller wall times were 341.539 and 343.217 seconds. This is integration verification, not independent physical validation; the old executable did not report replay memory or scratch telemetry.

Separate horizontal-overhang and detached-context edge fixtures passed all 36 checks at 1,024 and 4,096 finite-disc samples. Independent projected-disc quadrature (16,384 to 65,536 slices) changed by at most 1.986914e-7 relative; maximum error/tolerance was 0.103019. This establishes only finite direct visibility, not diffuse transport, glazing or arbitrary-building accuracy.
